heading: Process for adoption
lead: The adoption of the voluntary guidance under this part shall be carried out by the Commission in a manner that provides for each of the following:

tree.text: Publication of notice of the proposed recommendations in the Federal Register.
An opportunity for public comment on the proposed recommendations.
An opportunity for a public hearing on the record.
Publication of the final recommendations in the Federal Register.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 15502 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
